name: cellcell-crossfeed
description: A two-role cross-feeding pair (CpmColonyField) on a shared 60x60 grid: a 'secretor' CPM cell runs the flagship's microaerobic e_coli_core loop -- dynamic MM-limited glucose uptake (glucose_vmax 10.0), O2 capped at 15.0 to force mixed-acid overflow -- and secretes the byproduct acetate into a shared field. A 'consumer' CPM cell has its glucose exchange fixed off (role-driven) and instead runs dynamic MM-limited ACETATE uptake (acetate_vmax 10.0) with O2 uncapped-ish (oxygen_vmax 20.0) to respire it. The two cells are seeded a moderate distance apart so the secretor's acetate plume has to diffuse across open field before reaching the consumer's footprint -- acetate carries a higher diffusion coefficient than glucose so the handoff actually arrives. Glucose is uniform across the grid (feeds the secretor only; the consumer's glucose exchange is off so it can't touch it). Structural build target for task 3; regime tuning / cross-feeding handoff assertions are task 4.

provenance.source: task-3 cell-cell coupling regime composite (manual build)
